delta.comment: PR #457 review remediation (Push B): removed the dead blocks dependency 168-S -> 176-S (added in 6dfb2755). 176-S is archived/retired and never shipped, so the edge made 168-S permanently ineligible. The P-004 red-phase gate requirement 176-S carried remains OPEN (.backlogit/archive/176-S.md lines 44-52: harvest FRESH UNDER NEW IDS after 185-S and 187-S ship and the governing plan holds an independent PASS). No live queued shipment currently carries that requirement, so no replacement edge is added now; the P-004 gate edge on 168-S is added when the fresh P-004 shipment is harvested.

OPERATOR DIRECTION 2026-09-30: operator is deprecating the Copilot plugin channel and moving to a Go runtime with a zipped template bundle (stash F194A1D8, 62F0F6A8). This shipment's plugin-channel scope is likely obsolete; wheel-channel scope needs re-evaluation against the Go migration timeline. HOLD: do not claim until Stage re-plans (abandon vs. re-scope to wheel-only) and rewires successor 167-S. Recorded by Orchestrator; no status change made.

HOLD now enforced (PR #467 review): blocks edge 168-S -> 207-S (hold-gate shipment containing deliberation 039-DL). 207-S is edge-less and not dag-root, so pipeline-topology pre_claim blocks it as UNSEQUENCED_SHIPMENT; 168-S therefore cannot become eligible even after 166-S ships. Stage disposes 207-S/168-S after 039-DL is decided.
